prompt:
Create a native4K 16:9 setting bible sheet for ONE modest ancient Chinese rice shop, three geometrically consistent views on a warm gray ground. Clean restrained2D animation linework, broad muted color shapes, two-level shadows, no photographic texture or text.
The shop faces SOUTH onto an east-west river street. Inside, one straight low wooden COUNTER spans east-west along the NORTH back of the room, with just enough standing space behind it for the proprietor. A broad SOUTH opening leads directly to the street; the central aisle from counter to door has room for TWO people side by side. A few plain cloth rice sacks stand immediately INSIDE the WEST side of the threshold. ONE overturned plain bamboo basket with a flat upper surface sits OUTSIDE the EAST door jamb, on the STREET side of the facade, as a later book support; nothing rests on it now. Keep this east basket in the exact same place across all views, including the reverse interior view. All remaining floor and counter surfaces are empty.
A shallow eave projects only half a person's body depth beyond the threshold, leaving the open sky and street visible. Under the eave, a continuous EMPTY standing strip runs west-east for later listeners, with a clear approach from the WEST side of the street to the doorway. NO BENCHES, chairs, stools or other seating. NO LAMPS of any kind: no glass lantern, metal lantern, candle, flame or oil vessel; the future night lamp location is simply a blank patch on the counter. No people, animals, books, page weights, hanging signs, letters, modern fittings or decoration.
Layout: left two-thirds is the full storefront from the street SOUTH-SOUTHWEST, letting us see the north counter through the door, sacks inside left and overturned basket outside right. Upper-right is a roofless plan, north at the top, showing that same room and a short strip of street below. Lower-right is a view from behind the north counter looking south through the opening: the WEST sacks now appear on the viewer's RIGHT, and the outside EAST basket on the viewer's LEFT. Do not mirror the building. These are three views of the same single place, not three adjacent stores. Daylight from the south opening, warm gray lit planes and cool gray shadows, low-saturation brown timber and gray-beige stone. No labels, arrows, scales, captions or panel numbers.
